span.p:
1 · Browser
public key only · build refuses secrets in VITE_ · demo/review/dev tools compiled out

div.style: color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · Frontend guards (cosmetic)
ProtectedRoute · AdminGate · Guard(requires) · StaffAuthGate · ArtistPortalShell
nav from my_permissions()

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · JWT (Supabase Auth)
email OTP / password · auto refresh · role re-read every 60 s

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · Edge Function validation
auth.getUser() · ownership · input validation · CORS allow-list
HMAC signatures (Razorpay) · x-cron-secret

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · RPC (SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pinned)
has_permission() · auth.uid() checks · row locks · EXECUTE revoked from anon where not needed

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · Row-level security
~240 policies: own rows · permission · event scope · published-only

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 · Storage policies
folder = owner id · audience · published-only reads · signed URLs · size/type limits

div.style: color: rgb(17, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 · Constraints and guard triggers
role self-escalation · identity fields · application status · media review · event delete · CHECK constraints
